text: 1. Why choose to study this program? Architecture is an ancient discipline, the main focus includes Architecture Design, Urban Planning & Design, Interior Design, Gardening & Landscape Design, etc.. It illustrates technological, artistic and social characteristics, moreover, relating to the development of national economy and the construction of material and spiritual civilization of the society, in close attach with people's lives. This program aims to cultivate high-quality technical talents with a good quality of science, the innovation consciousness and international vision, the good engineering ethics and the comprehensive ability to solve the problem of complex civil engineering. The students have the ability of civil engineering technology and management, especially with obvious competitive advantage in the field of building engineering construction. 2. Program Introduction Urban Planning is a comprehensive discipline that is to study the future development and reasonable distribution of cities, comprehensive arranging and deploying all the urban projects and constructions, it is the blueprint of the urban development for certain period and the basis for construction and management of cities. Urban Planing program is aiming to develop engineering technological professionals who are capable at regional planning, overall planning, detailed planning, urban design, as well as architectural landscape design, decision-making consulting, real estate development, urban construction and management, etc.. 3. Skills Profile Students should have the ability in application of mathematics, natural sciences, engineering foundation and professional knowledge to solve complex engineering problems in civil engineering fields. Students of this program should acquire the knowledge and abilities as follows: Solid foundation in theory and professional knowledge of the field of civil engineering; Abilities in Chinese application; Abilities in practicing and application in computer science; Ability to understand, master and apply engineering management principles and economic decision-making methods in a multidisciplinary environment related to engineering and civil engineering. It has certain organizational, management, and leadership skills, and has the ability to analyze and solve practical problems related to civil engineering. 4. Fee structure Tuition: 18,000 RMB/year 5. Study Duration :4 Years 6. Degree Awarded:Bachelor of Engineering 7. Hours/ Credits:Minimum Credits of Curricular (comprising course system and intensified internship practical training): 120. 8. Introduction of Main Courses Fundamentals of Architectural Design; Fine Arts,Architectural Tectonics; Architectural Mechanics,Architectural Construction; History of Chinese and foreign Architecture; Architectural Physics; Principles of Architectural Design & Design; Principles of Urban Planning & Design; Principles of Urban Design & Design; Clickherefor four-years` detailed curriculum arrangement of theory and practice.
